edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the sender argument of transferFrom inside transfer
msg.sender controls the allowance branch and allowance mutation in transferFrom
delegate is gated solely by require(msg.sender == owner)
init is gated solely by require(msg.sender == owner)
batchSend is gated solely by require(msg.sender == owner)
setTradeAddress is gated solely by require(msg.sender == owner)
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom
transferFrom requires the ensure whitelist check
ensure falls through to require(condition(...)) for non-whitelisted senders
delegate executes a.delegatecall(b) with user-influenced target and data
transferFrom writes balanceOf[_from] with unchecked subtraction
transferFrom writes balanceOf[_to] with unchecked addition
transferFrom decrements allowance with unchecked subtraction
batchSend decrements balanceOf[msg.sender] with unchecked subtraction
batchSend increments balanceOf[_to] with unchecked addition in loop
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf mapping entries
transferFrom reads and writes allowance mapping entries
batchSend reads and writes balanceOf mapping entries
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] for the sender
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to bound sale count
condition compares _onSaleNum against _saleNum state limit
condition enforces _minSale lower bound on transfer value
condition enforces _maxSale upper bound on transfer value
ensure grants whitelist bypass when _from equals tradeAddress
ensure grants whitelist bypass when _from or _to equals owner
ensure grants whitelist bypass when canSale[_from] is true
_from parameter drives balance, allowance and ensure checks in transferFrom
_to parameter is the recipient forwarded by transfer
_value parameter is the amount forwarded by transfer
_spender parameter receives the allowance in approve
_tos array determines recipients and loop length in batchSend
address a is the delegatecall target in delegate
bytes b is the delegatecall payload in delegate
saleNum parameter sets _saleNum in init
token parameter sets _minSale in init
maxToken parameter sets _maxSale in init
addr parameter is written into tradeAddress in setTradeAddress
factory parameter is hashed into the pair address in pairFor
tokenA parameter is ordered and hashed in pairFor
tokenB parameter is ordered and hashed in pairFor
local total is computed in batchSend and drives the balance subtraction
loop index i controls iteration over _tos in batchSend
local _to receives _tos[i] and is credited in batchSend
